title: The Salt Pans
text: Shallow pans of salt shine white to the horizon, crusted and glittering, raked into neat rows by hands that are nowhere to be seen. Salt is gold, inland. Somewhere out on the flats, the salt-keepers are watching their pans.

options.label: Rake as much salt as you can carry.

outcomes.text: Heavy work, heavy packs, and the rows behind you raked smooth again by morning.

options.label: The slowest stays back to watch for the salt-keepers.

outcomes.text: They see them coming. You leave in time.

options.label: The shrewdest trades with the salt-keepers.

outcomes.text: Salt for iron, fair, with hands that are very dry.
